name: Gia
source: Holy priestess and [url=/c943]Nano[/url]'s lover. She was imprisoned by Olivia for saving [url=/c943]Nano[/url] and committed suicide after being defiled by men and out of grief in never seeing Nano again. She sometimes appears before [url=/c943]Nano[/url] as a spirit.
